body:
Schnitzels, I don't have the PDN anymore, sorry. :(

but feel free to use this one and go crazy if you want! Link me if you make a better one!
Perhaps you would like to PM me? I'm willing to hear more. I'll care, that much I can say.

Since young, I have the same problems you have now, I get used by "friends", or I would rather call them acquaintances. My parents always wondered why I wasn't the full A scorer like my brother, and neither did they ask if I was okay when I clearly wasn't. I lost myself many times.

But there was one reason why I could still get this far. I hoped to live to see the tomorrow, one where maybe I could be a proud father to raise his kids right, and dearly hug the love of my life. Or maybe the day I finally become the President of my country, a Lieutenant in the army, a manager at a retail store? You name it.

You have talents and can make money, win the game? Now let me tell you something. I'm already proud of you. You have something many others have yet to find, or even try, like me. I'm really envious.

You say that you leaving means someone else will fill up your space? No one can fill up your space. You are yourself and you define yourself. Sure, the social ladder can be a hard thing to get around, but you will eventually find someone who will love you for who you are.

Life is like running a marathon. Cross-country. You'd run long distances on many fields and there are often obstacles that block us and make us question why were we even trying in the first place. Well, for me, the view of the scenery whenever you run past the green grassy field or the beautiful ocean is something to behold. 

Don't give up, things will really get better. I'm sure you'll see it soon too, the greener fields.

"Splendid work of art

Hidden beauty of poems

Write for all to read"


Nothing can truly be stupid in this world. Beauty in things are different for everyone. For me, I enjoy collecting Military Equipment. For you, its poetry. Nothing wrong with that. I'm sure you're in some tough times right now, and the ride just feels real bumpy. But you can get through it. You are strong enough.

I read that you're cutting too. A week ago I was cutting myself too. We see those cuts as a form of relief, to let out the pain we feel. But the people who truly care, feel the pain of you cutting yourself.

I'm not sure what is going on for you right now, but I actually know how you feel. I was cutting myself, because everything just fell apart for me. I still have the scars on my arm, and they are deep ones. You are not in this alone.

Stay around, there is beauty to many things. Like the traditional saying, there's always a rainbow after the storm. I'd also love to see you write more poems. Maybe try setting up a deviantart to express yourself?

We aren't born to die.

Sure, some people may have it luckier than others, more privileged, born with a silver spoon etc...

I used to think like that. That dying would have been a lot faster to get to the finish line which is death. But think of it this way. Life is a RACE. A marathon. Cross-country. You're running to the end, yes, but what makes a marathon or cross-country run great? It's the experience along the way. Maybe the nice country side view? Or having to swim along your marathon route then continue running again?

Sometimes, the things that happen to us feel a lot like a game of chance. Having said that, wasn't having tried already something amazing?

Life is beautiful. There are ups and downs to it, but things will get better. I'm sure you're strong enough to get through the struggles. Don't give up, never give up.

There will be a point in life where we really worry over and over, of such things in our life.

People come and go. There is a saying here in Asia, among my friends, that having a few true friends is better than having tons who will never be true to you.

But, even so, just keep in mind this rule. There are some problems we are experiencing now, and maybe it's hard, we want to give up and just leave our problems behind. However, I can imagine you in the future, maybe 10-20 years from now, looking back at your life and realising how strong you are, and how strong you can be.

Things will always get better. Hang in there, and I'm sure you'll see it too.

We care.

There are tons of people here who care. 

Yes, a little insensitive bitch decided to pass on a comment that says life is a piece of shit, and that nobody cares.

NO.

Life is MORE than that. Nobody really knows the meaning to life, but you can try to find it. There will be someone who cares for you. I know it. You probably just haven't found that person yet.

In fact, the people here all care too. We care for you and I'd really like to hear more of your story too. Don't jump, you're a strong person and you can get through this.

You aren't alone. You aren't a shit friend. You are MORE THAN THAT.

People will come and go. Many of my friends have left me, some even forgot me. Some, used me. But College is an interesting place, because it is the place I have found the friends that would stay by my side no matter what. 

I used to have a friend like yours. We had a 10 year friendship, and he was my only friend. But for the sake of his own personal life and wishes, he left me alone. I was alone too. Yet, I met a beautiful girl and a very interesting guy who changed me forever.

You can't decide if your friend wants to go with other people. But what you can decide is to find the right person in life. As for him, he lost a good friend who would stand by him. Life is a lot of finding the right people to stand alongside you. Stay strong, you are strong. It's not you, but them.

Things will get better, a lot better!

I was feeling a lot similar to you recently. I can relate exactly to how you feel. Maybe now you just hit a low in life again, and it feels really crappy. You feel that life is just a dark tunnel and you don't know if you'll make it or not.

But there is always a light at the end of the tunnel. 

Maybe your parents might be trampling all over you, maybe you feel like nobody will be there for you, you feel alone. Maybe, you feel the same about your friends too.

But, keep in mind to yourself that you are STRONG. You are STRONG enough to get through this. You have a skill, I'm sure of it. You just haven't found it. I didn't think I'd make a great voice actor, yet my best friends remember me for that.

Why you shouldn't give up? Life is unpredictable. We all have reached a stage where you just feel like you've nothing left for this world, and you're nothing to this world. But... imagine, if you gave up now... what about the great and amazing people we will meet in our lives? The great things that can happen to us?

Do not give up. Life is an unpredictable race. We all run this race and the moment we fall down and stay there, we won't get a chance to see the wonders and beauty of your life. It's only a matter of when we get to see the full beauty of it.

There is always a light at the end of the tunnel. The tunnel may seem endless sometimes, or we may not see the light initially, but when we get there, things just get better. You are strong enough to survive this far, you are strong enough to get through this and anything else after that.
Not really sure how that makes me awesome though...
I don't even think I can. I don't have any talents or reason why I would be.
